_how: Each item is one cell in the playground grid, shown as the plain image at full column width. Put the image in assets/work/<folder>/ and list it here. size is the image's width×height in pixels. tags become the filter buttons. link is optional; without it, clicking opens the image larger. ratio (like "4:5") fits a transparent picture inside a box of that shape; bg sets that box's colour. Newest first.
